messages:
devops-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in TLS handshake failures observed via Cloudflare EU POPs. Elevated 5xx and handshake timeouts detected. Monitoring link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/handshake
ops_oncall: Ack. Im on it. Investigating now.
andrew: p95 latency up ~2s for POST /v1/generate, 5xx ~12% from eu-west (ams/cdg/fra). Graphs show start ~2027-02-10T14:15:00Z.
sarah: support queue seeing ~50 tickets referencing TLS/502/524 from EU. Escalating.
emma: scope check: EU-only? Any effect on Dedicated clusters?
andrew: looks EU-edge only; NA/APAC unaffected. Dedicated clusters still reachable via internal routing.
infra-sre: quick checks: `dig +short @8.8.8.8 api.redwood.ai A` returns origins. Curl to origin times out during TLS handshake: "SSL handshake timeout".
ops_oncall: Cloudflare console: "Partial POP outage - TLS handshake timeout" in EU region.
sarah: opened CF ticket CF-20270210-338 (level-1). Attached TLS logs + pcap. Pinged CF L2.
andrew: mitigation idea: route EU traffic to eu-fallback-host origin (bypass problematic POPs) and lower DNS TTL. Will evaluate WAF/cache tradeoffs.
emma: can Smart-Router do origin-direct fallback? We lose edge caching but keep availability.
infra-sre: implementing temporary Smart-Router rule: `route api.redwood.ai -> eu-fallback-host` and set DNS TTL=30s. Dry-run then flip.
ops_oncall: applying route change now.
ops_oncall: (deploy-bot) Route update applied: `api.redwood.ai` -> `eu-fallback-host`. DNS TTL lowered to 30s.
andrew: monitoring... 3 minutes in, EU 5xx down from 12% to ~5%. New connections improved, existing keepalives still failing.
sarah: status page draft ready. Posting: "Partial outage - EU CDN/TLS handshake failures. Working on mitigation." CS alerted for targeted customer comms.
support-bot: Status page updated: Partial outage in EU. Customers notified. :warning:
infra-sre: uploaded artifacts: `s3://incidents/20270210/pcap-eu-handshake.pcap` and TLS logs. Most failures show TLS alerts (unknown CA / handshake timeout).
andrew: sample curl output during failure:
```
$ curl -v --connect-timeout 10 https://api.redwood.ai/health
*   Trying 35.180.0.12:443...
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS alert, unknown CA
* SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate in certificate chain
* Closing connection 0
```
ops_oncall: notified Cloudflare weve placed fallback route; request CF to enable pop-level failover and consider TLS 1.2 fallback in affected POPs.
infra-sre: CF asked us to test while they apply mitigations. They mentioned possible internal cert validation issue or edge routing flap.
ops_oncall: CF L2 responded: disabling TLS 1.3 0-RTT on affected POPs and rerouting traffic internally as mitigation; will follow with RCA.
andrew: after CF mitigation + our fallback, EU 5xx down to ~1.5% and p95 latency back to baseline.
emma: plan for rollback: staged re-enable of Cloudflare edge during low traffic window; monitor handshake error rate and be ready to reapply fallback.
mike: taking over oncall in ~20m. Please leave handoff.
andrew: handoff note: mitigation active -> route to eu-fallback-host, DNS TTL 30s, status updated, CF ticket CF-20270210-338 open. Watching 5xx & TLS alerts. No origin-side errors. Pending CF RCA.
ops_oncall: handing off to mike now. Will be reachable for 30m. :handshake:
mike: taking over. Monitoring and coordinating with CF. Will keep fallback for at least 1 hour after stability, then start phased rollback.
sarah: support queue stabilized after status + fallback; new ticket rate dropped ~75%. CS & GtM prepping outreach to top EU customers.
infra-sre: added incident artifacts to tracker and Playbook note: `if CF POP TLS failures -> apply origin fallback -> lower TTL -> notify CF -> update status`.
andrew: postmortem TODOs: collect TLS/pcap/CF POP logs, timeline, affected customer count, and add automated route-fallback detection for future CF POP TLS anomalies.
ops_oncall: logged incident: INC-20270210-EU-CF-TLS (live incident board). Severity: high, customer-impact: partial EU.
mike: will keep monitoring and update channel with rollback plan. Escalate to infra-sre if regression on rollback.
ops_oncall: closing live handoff in thread. Final action: await CF RCA and include in postmortem once available. :white_check_mark:
